model.title: Rewrite: 'Seacole was determined. "at her own expense"'

parts.text: Find the key words: 'at her own expense'
Check it reads aloud as one sentence
Add a zoom on one word

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Seacole's decision to travel 'at her own expense' shows her determination: 'own' stresses that no one paid or asked her to go.

keywords.def: fit a quotation smoothly inside your own sentence
